transcript.text: I reviewed the signed artist license this morning and found three key constraints: Signal Garden may only be presented as ticketed sessions, the festival may not record it, and all visitor materials must use the credit wording 'Signal Garden by Nia Okafor'.

transcript.text: I completed an on-site accessibility assessment this week and found three key constraints: the installation can accommodate at most 40 people per session, it requires exactly four daily sessions rather than the six in the draft plan, and we need a 15-minute room reset between sessions for mobility equipment and sensory-access preparation.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Schedule exactly four daily ticketed sessions with a 15-minute room reset between sessions for mobility equipment and sensory-access preparation.

Set up ticketed admission for Signal Garden sessions at a maximum capacity of 40 people per session.
